q: Does a jewellery exporter in SEEPZ use the India grid factor for Scope 2?
title: SEEPZ jewellers: Scope 2 grid factor
short: Yes, for the location-based figure. Electricity drawn in an SEZ is still Indian grid power, so use 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. A lower market-based figure needs contractual instruments, such as renewable certificates or a green tariff, in your name.
audience: Gold and diamond jewellery exporters in SEEPZ, Mumbai

p: Market-based: kWh covered by instruments at their factor, the rest at the residual mix or grid average, as the guidance allows.
Bought gold and diamonds are purchased goods, Scope 3. They are separate from the unit's electricity.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
